note: 阅读迁移只使用《专四阅读句子库》/《专四阅读原文》里已有的句子，不编写、不机翻课文。已配上的各讲，都是同一语法现象确实出现在该长句里。原先沿用的五首（Talking to the Moon、Someone Like You、lovely、Blank Space、Count On Me）保持不动。配不上的歌仍留在 noPassageYet，不凑句。

Unstoppable.text: A second revelation is that when we expect to be able to find information again later on, we don’t remember it as well as when we think it might become unavailable.
Unstoppable.ask: unavailable 是怎么拼起来的？中间是哪个词？
Unstoppable.why: 中间是 available（能够得到），前面加 un，是反过来，合在一起就是得不到了。
Unstoppable.use: 和歌词里 unstoppable 一样，都是前缀、词根再加后缀拼成的派生词。
Unstoppable.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Unstoppable.text: For example, a study in the UK showed that people who write and spell badly are seen as careless, immature and unreliable, and often unintelligent.
Unstoppable.why: 中间是 rely，前面加 un，后面加 able，合在一起就是靠不住。
Unstoppable.use: 和 unstoppable 同一类：un、词根、able 拼起来。这句话里还有 unintelligent，也是同一现象。
Unstoppable.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Enemy.text: A second important reason why immigrants have traditionally been drawn to the United States is the belief that everyone has an equal chance to enter a race and succeed in the game.
Enemy.ask: everyone 看起来像很多人，这里动词用 has，还是 have？
Enemy.why: everyone 后面用 has，不用 have。虽然像是一群人，动词仍按单数。
Enemy.use: 和歌词里 Everybody wants 一样：everybody / everyone 后面动词仍用单数。
Enemy.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

One More Night.text: Attachment parents believe that love and comfort are free and necessary.
One More Night.ask: love and comfort 是两样东西并排做主语，后面用 are，还是 is？
One More Night.why: 两样东西用 and 并排做主语，后面用 are，不用 is。
One More Night.use: 和歌词里 You and I go 一样：两个主体并排，后面的动词按复数。
One More Night.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

One More Night.text: The lawlessness and poverty are only the obvious symptoms.
One More Night.ask: lawlessness and poverty 并排做主语，后面用 are，还是 is？
One More Night.why: 两样东西并排，后面用 are。
One More Night.use: 和 You and I go 同一现象：A and B 做主语，动词用复数。
One More Night.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

A Thousand Years.text: Over the next eight years, Harrington branched out even more: She started her own trucking business, added a cold-storage company, and now has three bakeries producing fresh buns and frozen dough — all now known as the Bun Companies.
A Thousand Years.ask: eight 后面的 year 要不要加 s？
A Thousand Years.why: 年数能一个个数，eight 后面要用 years，加 s。
A Thousand Years.use: 和歌词里 a thousand years 一样：能数的年，year 要加 s。
A Thousand Years.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

A Thousand Years.text: The aptly-named Fisher, who ran a commercial salvaging operation, had been trying to locate the underwater treasure for over 16 years when he finally hit the jackpot!
A Thousand Years.ask: 16 后面的 year 要不要加 s？
A Thousand Years.why: 16 年能一个个数，要用 years。
A Thousand Years.use: 和 a thousand years 同一现象。
A Thousand Years.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Hello My Love.text: No matter how many times you have seen images of the golden mask of boy king Tutankhamen, come face to face with it in Egypt's Cairo museum, and you will suck in your breath.
Hello My Love.ask: 埃及的博物馆，这里是怎么表示“谁的”？
Hello My Love.why: 用 Egypt's，先说谁，再加 's，再说那件东西。
Hello My Love.use: 和歌词里 father's eyes / mother's daughter 一样：用 's 表示所属。
Hello My Love.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Hello My Love.text: The counter-argument is that in professional, well-run operations such as Fisher's, each piece is accurately and minutely recorded and that it is this information which is more important than the actual object, and that such operations help increase our wealth of archaeological knowledge.indeed, as in Fisher's case, they make history more accessible to people through museum donations and information on web sites.
Hello My Love.why: Fisher's 是 Fisher 的（那种打捞做法），用 's 表示所属，后面的名词可以承前省掉。
Hello My Love.use: 和 father's / mother's 一样，都是用 's 表示谁的东西。
Hello My Love.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

All of Me.text: This, as all of Ireland knows, they hide at the end of the rainbow.
All of Me.ask: 说“整个爱尔兰都知道”，这里用的是哪一种 all？
All of Me.use: 和歌词里 all of me / all of you 一样：说全部时用 all of。
All of Me.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

In The End.text: This true story seems like a modern-day fairytale: a man pursues his dream through hardship and in the end, he triumphs over the difficulties—they all live happily ever after, right?
In The End.ask: 说到结局，这里 end 前面有没有 the？
In The End.why: 用 in the end。结局就一份，前面加 the。
In The End.use: 和歌词里 in the end 一样：就一份的结局，end 前面加 the。
In The End.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Love Yourself.text: There would be no one to live for during those coming years; she would live for herself.
Love Yourself.ask: 她要为谁而活？这里为什么用 herself，不用 her？
Love Yourself.why: 动作回到她自己身上，用 herself。
Love Yourself.use: 和歌词里 love yourself 一样：动作回到自己身上，用反身代词。
Love Yourself.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Love Yourself.text: Since they believe themselves to be descended from that ancestor, it would be like eating that ancestor or eating themselves.
Love Yourself.ask: believe 后面为什么用 themselves，不用 them？
Love Yourself.why: 他们信的是自己，动作回到自己身上，用 themselves。
Love Yourself.use: 和 love yourself 同一现象。
Love Yourself.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Talking to the Moon.text: "The more I read and discussed these practices, the more I realized this would help not only our budget but also our health," she says.
Talking to the Moon.ask: 这话她已经说过了。这里用 says，还是 said？
Talking to the Moon.why: 已经说过的事，嘴里用 says。听起来这话现在还在。
Talking to the Moon.translation: “我读得越多，讨论得越多，就越明白这不但能帮家里省钱，也能帮我们的身体。”她说。

choices.text: “我读得越多，讨论得越多，就越明白这不但能帮家里省钱，也能帮我们的身体。”她说。
“我读得越多，讨论得越多，就越明白这不但能帮家里省钱，也能帮我们的身体。”她当年说过。
choices.miss: 这句把已经说过的话读成了过去就结束了。

choices.text: “我读得越多，讨论得越多，就越明白这不但能帮家里省钱，也能帮我们的身体。”她将会这么说。
choices.miss: 这句把已经说过的话读成了还没说。

Talking to the Moon.paragraph: For Cindy, the recession began when her husband was relocated to Rhinelander, Wisconsin, by his company, forcing the family to move in a hurry. Then she stumbled upon an online community called Blotanical, a forum for gardeners, many with an interest in sustainability. "The more I read and discussed these practices, the more I realized this would help not only our budget but also our health," she says. Cindy admits that before the recession, she was a city girl with no interest in growing her own dinner.
Talking to the Moon.use: 搬家、发现论坛、读过、想明白，都已经发生了。she says 是作者在转述她说过的话。读成 said，会以为这话只停在过去。读成 says，才知道作者是把已经发生的事当着现在的话讲出来。

Talking to the Moon.text: Barbara Frederickson, a leading international authority on the importance of positive emotions, says humans are genetically programmed to seek positive emotions such as love and joy.
Talking to the Moon.ask: 这个判断她已经讲过了。这里用 says，还是 said？
Talking to the Moon.why: 已经讲过的话，用 says，不用 said。
Talking to the Moon.translation: 芭芭拉·弗雷德里克森是研究积极情绪的重要人物。她说，人天生就会去找爱和快乐这样的情绪。

choices.text: 芭芭拉·弗雷德里克森是研究积极情绪的重要人物。她说，人天生就会去找爱和快乐这样的情绪。
芭芭拉·弗雷德里克森是研究积极情绪的重要人物。她当年说过，人天生就会去找爱和快乐这样的情绪。
choices.miss: 这句把已经讲过的话读成了过去就结束了。

choices.text: 芭芭拉·弗雷德里克森是研究积极情绪的重要人物。她将会说，人天生就会去找爱和快乐这样的情绪。
choices.miss: 这句把已经讲过的话读成了还没说。

Talking to the Moon.paragraph: Finally, stress can be lessened if you love what you study. Barbara Frederickson, a leading international authority on the importance of positive emotions, says humans are genetically programmed to seek positive emotions such as love and joy. It is suggested to choose a major or career path you love and enjoy. Otherwise, you could end up fighting against your own biology.
Talking to the Moon.use: 这是文章在转述一个已经有的说法，不是她正要开口。says 把她早就讲过的判断放到现在来说。后面才劝你选自己喜欢的专业。

Nothing's Going to Change My Love For Yo.text: Probably thousands of people have already been using it, but I just discovered it, so I'm going to claim it and also name it: Fake Foning.
Nothing's Going to Change My Love For Yo.ask: 以后要去做这件事，这里用的是哪一种说法？
Nothing's Going to Change My Love For Yo.why: 用 be going to：I'm going to claim it。
Nothing's Going to Change My Love For Yo.use: 和歌词里 gonna / be going to 一样：以后也不会变、以后要发生，用 be going to。
Nothing's Going to Change My Love For Yo.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Nothing's Going to Change My Love For Yo.text: He would rather be a plumber's mate and do a real job that requires doing than learn about hydrostatics sitting at a desk, without understanding what practical use they are going to be.
Nothing's Going to Change My Love For Yo.ask: 以后会有什么用，这里用的是哪一种说法？
Nothing's Going to Change My Love For Yo.why: 用 are going to be，表示以后。
Nothing's Going to Change My Love For Yo.use: 和 gonna / be going to 同一现象。
Nothing's Going to Change My Love For Yo.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

If I Were a Boy.text: Suppose I were to comment on the beautiful weather we've been having when there was a monsoon at the other end of the phone?
If I Were a Boy.ask: 现在并不是那种情况，这里 If/Suppose 后面用 were，还是 was？
If I Were a Boy.why: 现在并不是，Suppose 后面用 were，表示假设。
If I Were a Boy.use: 和歌词里 If I were a boy 一样：现在不是那样，If / Suppose 后面用 were。
If I Were a Boy.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Stay.text: Cordia Harrington doesn't have to stand on her feet all day anymore.
Stay.ask: 说有没有必要整天站着，这里用的是哪一种说法？
Stay.why: 用 have to 表示必须或有必要做的事；这里是 doesn't have to，就是不必再这样做。
Stay.use: 和歌词里 All you have to do is stay 一样：用 have to 来说要做（或不必做）的那件事。
Stay.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Stay.text: Now, although Leprechauns are interesting characters, I have to admit that I was more interested in the stories of their treasure hoard.
Stay.ask: “我不得不承认”，这里用的是哪一种说法？
Stay.why: 用 have to，表示这件事得说出来。
Stay.use: 和 have to 同一现象。
Stay.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Someone Like You.text: First of all, it seems that a successful scientist is full of curiosity—he wants to find out how and why the universe works.
Someone Like You.ask: to 后面用的是哪一种？
Someone Like You.why: to 后面就说这件事本身，用 find。不用 found，也不加 will。
Someone Like You.translation: 首先，成功的科学家似乎总是充满好奇：他想弄清楚宇宙是怎么运作的，又为什么这样运作。

choices.text: 首先，成功的科学家似乎总是充满好奇：他想弄清楚宇宙是怎么运作的，又为什么这样运作。
首先，成功的科学家似乎总是充满好奇：他想正在弄清楚宇宙是怎么运作的，又为什么这样运作。
choices.miss: 这句把 to 后面读成了正在做。

choices.text: 首先，成功的科学家似乎总是充满好奇：他想已经弄清楚了宇宙是怎么运作的，又为什么这样运作。
choices.miss: 这句把 to 后面读成了已经做完。

Someone Like You.paragraph: What are these special methods of thinking and acting? First of all, it seems that a successful scientist is full of curiosity—he wants to find out how and why the universe works. He usually directs his attention towards problems which he notices have no satisfactory explanation, and his curiosity makes him look for underlying relationships even if the data available seem to be unconnected.
Someone Like You.use: 这一段在说科学家想做的那件事本身：弄清宇宙怎么运作。to 后面用 find，不是 found。你才知道这是他要去做的事，不是已经做完。

Someone Like You.text: Any engineer will recognize these as characteristic of a typical engineering problem, which doctors and engineers have worked together to solve, in order to bring a fresh lease of life to people who would otherwise be disabled.
Someone Like You.ask: to 后面用的是哪一种？
Someone Like You.why: to 后面用 solve，说的是这件事本身，不是已经做完。
Someone Like You.translation: 任何工程师都看得出，这是一个典型的工程问题。医生和工程师一起动手，就是为了解决它，好让那些本来会落下残疾的人重新过上日子。

choices.text: 任何工程师都看得出，这是一个典型的工程问题。医生和工程师一起动手，就是为了解决它，好让那些本来会落下残疾的人重新过上日子。
任何工程师都看得出，这是一个典型的工程问题。医生和工程师一起动手，就是为了正在解决它，好让那些本来会落下残疾的人重新过上日子。
choices.miss: 这句把 to 后面读成了正在做。

choices.text: 任何工程师都看得出，这是一个典型的工程问题。医生和工程师一起动手，就是为了已经解决了它，好让那些本来会落下残疾的人重新过上日子。
choices.miss: 这句把 to 后面读成了已经做完。

Someone Like You.paragraph: For many years hip-joints and other body joints have been replaceable either partially or completely. It is after all a simple ball and socket joint; it has certain loads imposed on it; it needs reliability over a defined life; it must contain materials suitable for the working environment. Any engineer will recognize these as characteristic of a typical engineering problem, which doctors and engineers have worked together to solve, in order to bring a fresh lease of life to people who would otherwise be disabled. This typifies the way in which engineers work to help people and create a better quality of life.
Someone Like You.use: 前面在说关节要受多大的力、坏了以后怎么办。to solve 说的是医生和工程师要一起做的这件事本身，不是已经做完。

Apologize.text: Still, according to Mar, it's too early to tell people to trade in their Danielle Steel for Alice Munro, at least if the goal is boosting empathy.
Apologize.ask: 还太早、还不能去做，这里用的是哪一种架子？
Apologize.why: 用 too ... to：too early to tell，太早了，还没法去告诉别人。
Apologize.use: 和歌词里 too late to apologize 一样：too + 形容词 + to，表示已经到那种程度，没法再做后面那件事。
Apologize.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Apologize.text: But we also don't want to subsidize the indolence of people who are too lazy to work.
Apologize.ask: 懒到不去工作，这里用的是哪一种架子？
Apologize.why: 用 too lazy to work：太懒了，不会去工作。
Apologize.use: 和 too late to apologize 同一现象。
Apologize.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

lovely.text: Seeing my adult son willingly cleaning that dirty bathtub gives me hope for the future of his 12-year-old brother who, instead of working, is found to be sleeping in the seat of the window he is supposed to be cleaning.
lovely.ask: Seeing 前面有没有 I am？
lovely.why: 看见这件事直接用 Seeing 开头，不必再写 I am。
lovely.translation: 看见成年的儿子愿意去刷那个脏浴缸，我就对那个 12 岁的弟弟有了盼头。弟弟本该擦窗户，却被人发现睡在窗座上。

choices.text: 看见成年的儿子愿意去刷那个脏浴缸，我就对那个 12 岁的弟弟有了盼头。弟弟本该擦窗户，却被人发现睡在窗座上。
我正在看见成年的儿子愿意去刷那个脏浴缸，就对那个 12 岁的弟弟有了盼头。弟弟本该擦窗户，却被人发现睡在窗座上。
choices.miss: 这句多读出了一个「正在」，原文没有 I am。

choices.text: 我已经看见过成年的儿子愿意去刷那个脏浴缸，就对那个 12 岁的弟弟有了盼头。弟弟本该擦窗户，却被人发现睡在窗座上。
choices.miss: 这句把这件事读成了已经看过。

lovely.paragraph: Maybe after all these years, he's finally grasped the concept. No matter. Seeing my adult son willingly cleaning that dirty bathtub gives me hope for the future of his 12-year-old brother who, instead of working, is found to be sleeping in the seat of the window he is supposed to be cleaning. "Awake and be clean!" I say.
lovely.use: 儿子已经在刷浴缸。这句话一开头就是 Seeing，没有 I am。你才知道作者是直接把看见这件事拿来说，不是在说自己正在看。

lovely.text: Saying "thank you" is probably the first thing most of us learn to do in a foreign language.
lovely.ask: Saying 前面有没有 I am？
lovely.why: 道谢这件事直接用 Saying，不必再写 I am。
lovely.translation: 说“谢谢”，大概是我们学一门外语时最先会做的事。

choices.text: 说“谢谢”，大概是我们学一门外语时最先会做的事。
我正在说“谢谢”，大概是我们学一门外语时最先会做的事。
choices.miss: 这句多读出了一个「正在」，原文没有 I am。

choices.text: 我已经说过“谢谢”，大概是我们学一门外语时最先会做的事。
choices.miss: 这句把这件事读成了已经做过。

lovely.paragraph: Saying "thank you" is probably the first thing most of us learn to do in a foreign language. After all, we're brought up to be polite, and it is important to make a good impression upon other people — especially across national divides.
lovely.use: 文章一开头就用 Saying 把“说谢谢”这件事拿出来，后面才讲还有别的说法。前面没有 I am。读成正在说，这一段的意思就偏了。

Blank Space.text: Cordia Harrington was tired of standing up all day and smelling like French fries at night.
Blank Space.ask: tired 是正在厌倦，还是已经厌倦成那样？
Blank Space.why: tired 是已经厌倦成那样，不是正在厌倦。
Blank Space.translation: 科迪娅·哈林顿已经厌倦了成天站着，晚上还一身炸薯条的味道。

choices.text: 科迪娅·哈林顿已经厌倦了成天站着，晚上还一身炸薯条的味道。
科迪娅·哈林顿正在变得厌倦成天站着，晚上还一身炸薯条的味道。
choices.miss: 这句把已经是那样读成了正在。

choices.text: 科迪娅·哈林顿准备去厌倦成天站着，晚上还一身炸薯条的味道。
choices.miss: 这句把已经是那样读成了打算去做。

Blank Space.paragraph: Cordia Harrington was tired of standing up all day and smelling like French fries at night. She owned and operated three McDonald's shops in Illinois, but as a divorced mother of three boys, she yearned for a business that would provide for her children and let her spend more time with them.
Blank Space.use: 文章一开头她就已经厌倦成那样了。后面才讲她后来怎么改行。tired 要读成已经是那样，不是正在变得厌倦。

Blank Space.text: He is skeptical — he does not accept statements which are not based on the most complete evidence available—and therefore rejects authority as the sole basis for truth.
Blank Space.ask: based 是已经落在证据上，还是正在建立？
Blank Space.why: based 是已经落在证据上的样子，不是正在去建立。
Blank Space.translation: 他抱着怀疑：没有建立在现有最完整证据上的说法，他不接受，因此也不把权威当成真理的唯一来源。

choices.text: 他抱着怀疑：没有建立在现有最完整证据上的说法，他不接受，因此也不把权威当成真理的唯一来源。
他抱着怀疑：没有正在建立在现有最完整证据上的说法，他不接受，因此也不把权威当成真理的唯一来源。
choices.miss: 这句把已经是那样读成了正在。

choices.text: 他抱着怀疑：将来才会建立在现有最完整证据上的说法，他不接受，因此也不把权威当成真理的唯一来源。
choices.miss: 这句把已经是那样读成了还没发生。

Blank Space.paragraph: He is skeptical — he does not accept statements which are not based on the most complete evidence available—and therefore rejects authority as the sole basis for truth. Scientists always check statements.
Blank Space.use: 这一段在讲科学家什么样：说法必须已经落在现有最完整的证据上，他才接受。based 要读成已经是那样，不是正在去建立。

Perfect.text: He'd just had a hip operation and looked terrible.
Perfect.ask: 说他当时看上去怎样，这里用的是 look 加什么？
Perfect.why: 用 looked 再加形容词 terrible，直接说看上去的样子。
Perfect.use: 和歌词里 look perfect 一样：用 look + 形容词说某个人怎样。
Perfect.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Perfect.text: But every time I made a move to get it some passing eye detected my purpose, and of course I straightened up then, and looked indifferent and pretended that I hadn’t been thinking about the pear at all.
Perfect.ask: 说自己看上去怎样，这里用的是 look 加什么？
Perfect.why: 用 looked indifferent，后面直接跟形容词。
Perfect.use: 和 look perfect 同一现象。
Perfect.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Shape of You.text: He first fell in love with wildlife photography in the sweltering savannas of Tanzania,Africa.
Shape of You.ask: 说爱上某样东西，这里介词用的是哪个？能丢掉吗？
Shape of You.why: 用 in love with，with 不能丢。
Shape of You.use: 和歌词里 in love with the shape of you 一样：爱上要用 in love with，with 要留下来。
Shape of You.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Let It Go.text: An hour later, he called to let me know it was ready.
Let It Go.ask: 让我知道这件事，let 后面的动词是怎么用的？
Let It Go.why: 用 let me know：let 后面直接跟原形动词 know，不加 to。
Let It Go.use: 和歌词里 Let it go 一样：叫人或让人做，用 Let + 人/物 + 最简单的那个动词。
Let It Go.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Rolling in the Deep.text: And then there is the researchers’ final observation: the expectation that we'll be able to locate information down the line leads us to form a memory not of the fact itself but of where we'll be able to find it.
Rolling in the Deep.ask: 先把这件事引出来，这里用的是哪一种开头？
Rolling in the Deep.why: 用 there is，先说有这么一项观察。
Rolling in the Deep.use: 和歌词里 There's a fire 一样：先说有没有，用 There is / There's。
Rolling in the Deep.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Rolling in the Deep.text: For those fresh out of university, desperate for work but unable to get it, there is a big imbalance The latest unemployment figures show that 746,000 of 18-24 year-olds are unemployed— a record rate of 18 per cent.
Rolling in the Deep.ask: 先说有一种不平衡，这里用的是哪一种开头？
Rolling in the Deep.why: 用 there is a big imbalance。
Rolling in the Deep.use: 和 There's a fire 同一现象。
Rolling in the Deep.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Try Everything.text: When McDonald’s decided it wanted a new bun supplier, Harrington became determined to win the contract, even though she had no experience running a bakery.
Try Everything.ask: 即便没有经验还是要去争，这里用的是哪一种连接？
Try Everything.why: 用 even though，后面跟完整的一句：she had no experience running a bakery。
Try Everything.use: 和歌词里 even though I could fail 一样：即使怎样，还是要做，even though 后面是一句完整的话。
Try Everything.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Count On Me.text: If you live in a society where most people are literate, then you will feel ashamed or embarrassed and avoid situations in which you have to read or write.
Count On Me.ask: 亮出来的这截，说的是以后的事。这里用的是现在，还是加了 will？
Count On Me.why: If 后面是 live，没有 will。will 在后面那句 you will feel。
Count On Me.translation: 如果你生活在一个大多数人都会读写的社会里，你就会感到羞愧或尴尬，并躲开那些要你读或写的场合。

choices.text: 如果你生活在一个大多数人都会读写的社会里，你就会感到羞愧或尴尬，并躲开那些要你读或写的场合。
如果你将来生活在一个大多数人都会读写的社会里，你就会感到羞愧或尴尬，并躲开那些要你读或写的场合。
choices.miss: 这句把 If 后面读成了「将来」。

choices.text: 如果你生活在一个大多数人都会读写的社会里，你已经感到羞愧或尴尬，并躲开了那些要你读或写的场合。
choices.miss: 这句把后面 will 的事读成了已经发生。

Count On Me.paragraph: If you live in a society where most people are literate, then you will feel ashamed or embarrassed and avoid situations in which you have to read or write. The father of a friend of mine finally admitted to his family that he couldn't read when he was 45 years old. He bought the newspaper every day and pretended to read it — and believe it or not, his family had no idea.
Count On Me.use: 这一段先说以后会怎样：生活在人人都会读写的地方，你就会觉得丢脸，躲开要读写的场合。后面那个人 45 岁才承认不会读，是已经发生的事。If 后面用 live，你才分得清：条件当现在说，丢脸是以后的事。

Count On Me.text: If any amount of stress is left unchecked, many things can occur within the body, including premature aging, impaired cognitive function and energy drain.
Count On Me.mark: If any amount of stress is left
Count On Me.ask: 亮出来的这截，说的是压力要是一直不管。这里用的是现在，还是 will？
Count On Me.why: If 后面是 is left，没有 will。后面才是会发生的事。
Count On Me.translation: 如果压力一直不管，身体里会发生很多事，包括提前变老、脑子变慢、精力被耗掉。

choices.text: 如果压力一直不管，身体里会发生很多事，包括提前变老、脑子变慢、精力被耗掉。
如果压力将来一直不管，身体里会发生很多事，包括提前变老、脑子变慢、精力被耗掉。
choices.miss: 这句把 If 后面读成了「将来」。

choices.text: 如果压力已经被放着不管了，身体里的这些事都已经发生了。
choices.miss: 这句把以后可能发生的事读成了已经发生。

Count On Me.paragraph: Second, the human body doesn't discriminate between a big stressful event and a little one. Any stressful experience will create about 1,400 biochemical events in your body. If any amount of stress is left unchecked, many things can occur within the body, including premature aging, impaired cognitive function and energy drain.
Count On Me.use: 前面在讲压力已经进了身体。这一句接着说：要是一直不管，以后身体里还会发生什么。is left 当现在说，后面 can occur 才是以后的事。

You Belong With Me.text: My mother was amazed because the woman who lived next door always wrote a list of what she needed before she went to the supermarket.
You Belong With Me.ask: 是哪一个女人？这里用什么把那个人补出来？
You Belong With Me.why: 用 the woman who lived next door，用 who 补上是哪一个。
You Belong With Me.use: 和歌词里 the one who understands you 一样：用 who 引导的从句，把那个人补清楚。
You Belong With Me.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

You Belong With Me.text: For anyone who doubts that the texting revolution is upon us, consider this: The average 13-to 17-year-old sends and receives 3,339 texts a month—more than 100 per day, according to the Nielsen Co., the media research firm.
You Belong With Me.ask: 是哪一种人？这里用什么补出来？
You Belong With Me.why: 用 anyone who doubts，用 who 补上是哪种人。
You Belong With Me.use: 和 the one who 同一现象。
You Belong With Me.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Love Story.text: She said, “What is the worst thing that can happen?We lose the house, we sell our cars, and we start all over again.
Love Story.why: 原话跟在 She said 后面，用引号把当时那句话带出来。
Love Story.use: 和歌词里 And I said 后面接原话一样：这是直接引语。
Love Story.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Love Story.text: Still watching the mother,I said, "Mind some advice?"" “Sure,” said the daughter.
Love Story.why: 原话跟在 I said 后面；后面 “Sure,” said the daughter 也是同一现象。
Love Story.use: 和 I said + 原话一样。
Love Story.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Yellow.text: I know when the snow melts and the first robins(知更鸟） come to call, when the laughter of children returns to the parks and playgrounds, something wonderful is about to happen.
Yellow.ask: wonderful 放在 something 的前面，还是后面？
Yellow.why: 要放在 something 后面：something wonderful。
Yellow.use: 和歌词里 something beautiful 一样：something / anything / nothing 这类词，形容词要放后面。
Yellow.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

Yellow.text: Maybe something useful will come of Clinton’s idea, but I'm not all that hopeful.
Yellow.ask: useful 放在 something 的前面，还是后面？
Yellow.use: 和 something beautiful 同一现象。
Yellow.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

I'm Not The Only One.text: This consisted of a large, long room at opposite ends of which two undermasters conducted the second and third forms, and of a smaller one, leading out of it, used by Mr. Watson, who taught the first form.
I'm Not The Only One.ask: one 在这里代替什么？还要不要把 room 再说一遍？
I'm Not The Only One.why: one 代替前面刚说的 room，不必再把名词说一遍。
I'm Not The Only One.use: 和歌词里 the only one 一样：用 one 代替刚说的那种事物或那种人。
I'm Not The Only One.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）

I'm Not The Only One.text: The older woman detached from the younger one and began to tick through the DVDs on the nearest shelf.
I'm Not The Only One.ask: the younger one 代替的是谁？
I'm Not The Only One.why: one 代替前面的 woman，就是那个年纪更小的女人。
I'm Not The Only One.use: 和 the only one 同一现象：用 one 代替刚说的那种人。
I'm Not The Only One.source: 专四阅读句子库（对应《专四阅读原文》，不新编课文）
